perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Zen Moment

perks.name: Gutshot Straight

perks.name: Cooling Baubles
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.desc: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Imperial Allegiance
perks.desc: Being near allies grants increased cooling or charge rate, and increased damage while at high heat or low guard energy.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Solar-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with Solar builds. Zealous Ideal is a balanced heat auto rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "strict downgrade from adaptive". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, there's an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the Destiny Data Compendium. With the Recoil Direction already at 95, you can take your pick with the barrel perk to boost Handling, Stability or Range. In the battery perk slot, look for something that reduces heat generation, or improves cooling efficiency or vent speed. In the first trait perk slot, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~21 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. You'll need a Solar subclass with a scorch ability to make the most of Burning Ambition in the second column to build Solar ignitions on tougher targets - if you can't apply scorch first, it'll take ~21 hits within 2s of each other to apply +10 scorch stacks with +10 added on each additional hit to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. Aegis ranks the Imperial Allegiance origin trait as A-Tier for PvE if you're in a fireteam - it stacks up to ×3 per ally within 15m, boosting cooling by a max ×1.105 and increasing damage when above 50% heat by max ×1.105. If you're interested, this is modelled on the E-11 medium blaster rifle, the standard-issue weapon for the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers, while the name refers to the rigid, uncompromising pursuit of a perfect standard or cause. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for single-target damage against tougher enemies in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly for solar builds. Zealous Ideal is a Balanced Heat frame auto rifle, with a precision firing rate, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being similar in performance to other autos. The heat frame is like an extra perk set, first providing reduced heat generation, significantly increasing the number of shots before overheating, and providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, there's an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×2 vent rate if you manually reload when the heat bar is at >87.5% of maximum heat to proc Perfect Vent, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with other precision autos - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/1863583117 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance, once the formulas have been worked out. With the effect of the precision intrinsic reducing horizonal yaw to ×0.8 you can ignore Recoil Direction and focus on Handling with the barrel perk. For the heatsink perk, look for something that reduces heat generation, or improves cooling efficiency or vent speed. For an auto to use in underleveled content, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after 21 hits within 5s of each other to proc all your useful armour mods - you'll spawn 2-3 orbs from cold to overheated, depending on the heatsink perk. Burning Ambition works to build ignitions on tougher targets - it's faster with a solar ability to apply scorch initially, otherwise it'll take ~16 hits to apply +10 scorch stacks with stacks added on additional hits to build towards an ignition at 100. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. The Origin Trait, Imperial Allegiance grants a stack for each ally in 15m, up to ×3, to boost both the cooling rate and damage when heat is >50% by up to a max of ×1.105, so is ideal for working in a fireteam. If you're interested, this is modelled on the E-11 medium blaster rifle, the standard-issue weapon for the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers. Recommended MW: Cooling Efficiency, with a Heat Generated mod or your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
